provenance.ref: Only exact current-slate DraftKings IDs enter runtime joins.

dk_identity.covers: A DraftKings ID, draft group, salary row or entry file the delivered rosters rest on is unknown, mixed or not the exact current slate's.

provenance.ref: A Classic/Showdown mismatch is a hard stop in either path.

slate_mode.covers: A file, policy, bank, lineup or builder is for the other contest mode, or the slate has the wrong shape for its mode.

roster_legality.covers: A lineup breaks DraftKings roster rules (slots, salary cap, a person twice, games or teams) or holds a person whose game has locked, or a solver returned one.

provenance.ref: Before lock, fill only blank roster cells belonging to the exact Entry IDs the supplied template authorizes.

entry_authority.covers: Entry ID mapping, coverage or order, blank-cell authority, or a prefilled or unauthorized row.

provenance.ref: Integrity gates (exact DraftKings IDs, hashes, entry mapping, blank-cell authority, locked cells, Classic/Showdown mode) still stop the file they protect.

delivered_bytes.covers: The delivered bytes are not provably the template's bytes with the audited rows filled: a byte, reparse or post-write check failed, or a DraftKings input changed during the run.

provenance.ref: Integrity gates (exact DraftKings IDs, hashes, entry mapping, blank-cell authority, locked cells, Classic/Showdown mode) still stop the file they protect.

audited_selection.covers: The lineups being written are not provably the audited selection: an assignment, bank, selection or audit record is missing, malformed, unbound or disagrees with another.

provenance.ref: Integrity gates (exact DraftKings IDs, hashes, entry mapping, blank-cell authority, locked cells, Classic/Showdown mode) still stop the file they protect.

policy_binding.covers: A portfolio policy is bound to other salaries, entries, games or people than the run's, so it would be applied to the wrong ones.

provenance.ref: C2 Classic policy, candidate bank, assignment, and selection audit

operator_restriction.covers: A delivered lineup holds a person an exact exclusion names, or an exclusion names nobody the slate holds.

distinct_lineups.covers: A portfolio repeats a lineup, or holds too few distinct lineups for its rows; the rows short of one stay unfilled and are named.

provenance.ref: Never overwrite an uploaded file, a filled entry, an earlier output, or anything in `data/standings/inbox/`.

no_overwrite.covers: An output file, run folder or work root already exists.

provenance.ref: no operating profile writes `DK_UPLOAD` (`certify` and governed `late-swap` can).

prohibited_artifact.covers: A review path would write an upload-named artifact.

provenance.ref: Governed late swap has its own command and may change only cells independently proven replaceable.

late_swap_state.covers: The current template, the prior output or the locked cells a swap starts from are not the ones proven.

delivery_coverage.covers: An authorized row has no delivered lineup and no other gate names why.

gate_registry.covers: The gate registry is unreadable or malformed, or a code it does not hold was asked for, so no gate can be named.

portfolio_bounds.covers: An exposure, captain, team, game, group, stack, overlap or salary bound is breached, contradictory or infeasible, or captains repeat.

search_budget.covers: A candidate bank or joint selection hit its time, search or size budget, or the bank ran out before the portfolio filled; the rung ladder's triggers.

strategy_observation.covers: A strategy observation about stacks, salary use, exposure envelopes or family coverage; never a roster prohibition.

provenance.ref: Official activity evidence needs an HTTPS source and a timezone-aware observation time.

official_activity.covers: Official activity evidence is missing, stale, future, changed, incomplete for a selected person, or says a selected person is not active.

participation_shortfall.covers: The pool left after DraftKings-status, activity, role and operator exclusions cannot build a lineup. The excluded people stay out; the rows left unfilled are named by an integrity limitation.

unresolved_role_change.covers: A person in TRANSFER_PRIOR_UNVERIFIED who trips SALARY_RANK_DIVERGENCE. R28 absorbs the 2026-09-19 P1 hard stop (Ben, 2026-09-23): he is left out of the pool, never selected on the old-team share, and named.

participation_evidence.covers: A DraftKings status is unrecognized or classified two ways, so participation cannot be claimed.

offensive_roles.covers: Current offensive-role or offensive-history evidence is missing, stale, unbound, conflicted or unsupported.

kicker_roles.covers: Kicker-role evidence is missing, stale, unbound, conflicted or unsupported.

qb_depth_roles.covers: Quarterback or depth-chart role evidence is missing, stale, unbound, conflicted or unsupported.

weather.covers: Weather capture, state, roof or expiry evidence is missing, stale, unbound or conflicted.

source_policy.covers: An evidence source, parser, licence or path is not approved, so the evidence it would supply is refused and the boundary holds.

provenance.ref: W1 nflverse prior adapter (producer of the S6A sources)

prior_package.covers: The prior package or a source it reads is missing, expired, unbound, malformed or changed.

projection_package.covers: The projection package, its ledger or a source it archives is missing, expired, unbound, malformed or changed.

provenance.ref: Fuzzy or normalized identity matches are proposals and cannot certify.

provider_identity.covers: A provider identity, team crosswalk or identity review does not reconcile exactly to the current slate.

provenance.ref: Never freehand a model value or let prose research write a number without a validated contract.

model_arithmetic.covers: A model value is non-finite, out of contract, unconserved, divides by zero or lacks the support it needs.

provenance.ref: `OPTIMAL` is scoped to the reported bank

selection_claims.covers: A claim about the selection (its scores, optimality, solver proof or scope) cannot be reproduced.

provenance.ref: Cold-start projections, ownership, fields, duplication estimates, and scenario utilities are diagnostics or priors.

qa_evidence.covers: A simulation, referee, sensitivity, duplication or validation diagnostic did not pass.

contest_economics.covers: Payouts, field size, ticket value or advertised prize value are missing.

certification_prerequisite.covers: Something certification alone requires is missing or failed: hard evidence, model inputs, a source ledger, a build report, a prior certification, a preflight binding, the environment check or the process budget.

classic_policy_input.covers: A Classic portfolio policy is malformed or uses an unsupported field, type, schema or rule; the optional policy is dropped.

showdown_policy_input.covers: A Showdown portfolio policy is malformed or uses an unsupported field, type, schema or rule; the optional policy is dropped.

run_request.covers: A run request asks for something its profile does not accept or leaves out an input the request needs.

implementation_limit.covers: A path does not support this contest shape or entry file (several contests, mixed fees, a partly prefilled template); another path may.

presentation.covers: A readable review, workbook or report could not be built, written or reconciled; the independently validated file is unaffected.

stage_failure.covers: A model-path stage (priors, projection, selection) failed; the stage's own code is in the detail.

prelock_manifest.covers: The pre-lock run manifest is incomplete or malformed.

settlement.covers: Post-slate settlement, grading or promotion cannot proceed; it stops a grade or a promotion claim, never a file.
